title: Unnamed Orphan 004
summary: A unnamed orphan with shaved brown hair and a plump build lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Growing up at Rotterdam Orphanage, this orphan would regularly bully Harrison Fears with the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, he and the other orphans began training for them. [Den vs Harrison]

This orphan was eventually enrolled into Tantras' class of students and was sent to eliminate Den for betraying the Blood Spiral. He restrained Dante Vale with Unnamed Orphan 005 and both were ensnared in Tantras' Skingrip power who did not care about hitting them too with his Bladewave. He was blasted back as the spell was repelled by Sophie Casterwill's Honorguard power. Tantras and his class then retreated after seeing Lok Lambert possessed a Powerbonded Titan. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Like the other orphans, this orphan was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented Harrison at any opportunity. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}

full_text:
A unnamed orphan with shaved brown hair and a plump build lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

History

Growing up at Rotterdam Orphanage, this orphan would regularly bully Harrison Fears with the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, he and the other orphans began training for them. [Den vs Harrison]

This orphan was eventually enrolled into Tantras' class of students and was sent to eliminate Den for betraying the Blood Spiral. He restrained Dante Vale with Unnamed Orphan 005 and both were ensnared in Tantras' Skingrip power who did not care about hitting them too with his Bladewave. He was blasted back as the spell was repelled by Sophie Casterwill's Honorguard power. Tantras and his class then retreated after seeing Lok Lambert possessed a Powerbonded Titan. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Personality

Like the other orphans, this orphan was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented Harrison at any opportunity. [Den vs Harrison]

Abilities

This orphan was a thug who picked on those weaker than him. [Den vs Harrison] However, after training with the Blood Spiral, he developed the standard Blood Spiral powers. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

• Augerfrost
